description: This file is a Python module responsible for managing the database layer of the mobile service website project. It defines functions for schema initialization, data seeding, CRUD operations for bookings, services, device catalogs, site content, admin users, and other related data. It handles database connection management, table creation, updates, and data retrieval.

methods.name: str get_db_path()
methods.description: Returns the path to the SQLite database, either from environment variable 'SQLITE_DB' or defaulting to a local myapp.db file.

methods.name: None init_schema()
methods.description: Creates the necessary database tables and seeds initial data if they do not exist, including services, customer requests, bookings, device catalogs, admin users, and site content.

methods.name: list[dict] list_services()
methods.description: Retrieves a list of service entries ordered by display order for frontend use.

methods.name: list[dict] list_booking_services()
methods.description: Returns available repair services for booking UI step 3.

methods.name: list[dict] list_brands()
methods.description: Lists device brands available for selection in the booking flow.

methods.name: list[dict] list_models_for_brand(brand: str)
methods.description: Provides models associated with a specific brand.

methods.name: dict get_site_content(keys: list[str])
methods.description: Fetches multiple site content key-value pairs based on provided keys.

methods.name: int create_customer_request(name: str, phone: str, email: str, mobile_model: str, problem: str)
methods.description: Inserts a new customer repair request record and returns its ID.

methods.name: int create_booking(name: str, phone: str, pincode: str)
methods.description: Creates a new booking record with minimal info, returns booking ID.

methods.name: dict|None update_booking_device_selection(booking_id: int, brand: str | None, model: str | None, service: str | None)
methods.description: Updates fields for brand, model, and service for a specific booking and returns the updated record.

methods.name: list[dict] list_bookings(limit: int = 200)
methods.description: Retrieves recent booking records for administrative overview.

methods.name: dict|None get_booking_by_id(booking_id: int)
methods.description: Fetches detailed info for a specific booking by its ID.

methods.name: dict|None get_latest_booking_by_phone(phone: str)
methods.description: Retrieves the most recent booking associated with a given phone number.

methods.name: dict|None update_booking_status(booking_id: int, status: str, notes: str | None = None)
methods.description: Updates the status and notes of an existing booking and retrieves the latest record.

methods.name: bool verify_admin_credentials(username: str, password: str)
methods.description: Checks provided admin username/password against stored data.
